name: ams OSRAM
old_description: Since 1906, the OSRAM brand has stood for continuous progress through light. On its 120th anniversary, it looks back on a unique history of innovation — and, as part of ams OSRAM, looks ahead to the world of Digital Photonics.
about:
ams OSRAM traces its roots to 1906 when the OSRAM brand was established in Germany as a pioneer in electric lighting. Today the company operates as a global technology group headquartered in Premstaetten near Graz, Austria, with a co-headquarters in Munich, Germany, and a significant U.S. presence in Novi, Michigan. The business combines the legacy of OSRAM's 120-year history with ams' sensor expertise following their merger, creating a unified photonics powerhouse. No individual founders are named in the company's public history.

The group designs and manufactures semiconductor-based light emitters, optical sensors, CMOS integrated circuits, and supporting software, alongside traditional lighting technologies for automotive and specialty applications. Its product portfolio spans time-of-flight sensors such as the TMF8829 multi-zone dToF module, automotive signaling LEDs like the SYNIOS P2222, compact headlamp sources (OSLON Compact RM), addressable interior RGB devices (OSIRE E3030), infrared emitters for eye tracking, and VCSEL drivers for augmented reality. With approximately 18,500 employees worldwide, the company holds roughly 12,000 patents and patent applications and reported EUR 3.3 billion in revenue for 2025.

Customers span automotive and mobility (including interior lighting systems like ALIYOS and exterior signaling), medical and health (UV-C LED disinfection adopted by brands such as UPANG for baby bottle sterilizers), industrial automation, mobile and wearable devices, general lighting, and computing. The company cites collaborations with license partners to advance technological expertise across these sectors.

The company states its differentiation lies in "sensing the power of light" – harnessing the full spectrum, visible and invisible, to add intelligence to illumination. Its vision is to inspire people with innovative light and sensor solutions, while its mission emphasizes pioneering differentiating technologies that make the world safer, smarter, and more sustainable through long-term customer partnerships.

name: pan pacific plastics mfg inc
old_description: Founded in 1981 and headquartered in Northern California, Pan Pacific manufactures and imports a full line of packaging, specifically producing various types of bags made from paper and plastic. In Hayward, CA we do all the plastic extruding, printing and converting in our expanded manufacturing facility. In addition, we have several manufacturing partnerships located throughout Asia offering unlimited paper and plastic products and capacities.
about:
Founded in 1981 in Hayward, California, Pan Pacific Plastics Mfg Inc is a woman-owned and minority-certified packaging manufacturer. The company began as a domestic producer of paper and plastic bags and later expanded with overseas manufacturing partnerships across Asia.

The company manufactures and imports a full line of packaging, specializing in bags made from paper and plastic. At its Hayward facility, Pan Pacific performs plastic extrusion, printing, and converting in an expanded manufacturing plant. Through its Asian partnerships, it offers additional capacity for paper and plastic products. The firm maintains an in-house graphic art department for artwork proofs and design support, and operates quality control inspections at both factory and warehouse levels.

Pan Pacific serves a broad range of industries, including grocery, retail, promotional, industrial, agricultural, food service, airline, travel, and hospitality. Its customer base includes major distributors and various Fortune 500 companies, as well as small businesses and individual consumers worldwide.

Pan Pacific emphasizes complete control over every production step—domestically and overseas—to ensure quality and consistency. It differentiates itself with low domestic minimums (as little as 100 lbs of plastic), short domestic lead times of four to six weeks, price protection programs that lock in pricing for up to a year, and a responsive customer support model backed by over 100 years of combined staff experience.

about:
10 Men Metal Fabrication operates from Omaha, Nebraska, where it was established in 2019 by owner Jaco Germishuys. The company began with a vision to serve as a one-stop shop for architectural sheet metal and custom fabrication across the Midwest, drawing on the combined decades of experience of its founding team.

The shop provides a full range of architectural metal fabrication services, including shearing, folding, welding, perforating, and metal finishing. Its product line covers standing seam roof panels, custom trim, vented ridge caps, column covers, cornice metal, gutters, downspouts, conductor heads, scuppers, flashings, copings, and specialty items such as copper and zinc countertops, backsplashes, and custom planters. The facility is described as a fully equipped metal shop, and the team has completed over 500 projects.

The company serves contractors, architects, homeowners, and DIY enthusiasts primarily throughout the Midwest. Its customer base spans the construction, architectural, roofing, and drainage industries, with projects ranging from standard architectural components to unique custom designs.

10 Men Metal Fabrication differentiates itself through its ANSI ES-1 certification for metal roofing components and the ability to fabricate UL-certified flashings and copings. The firm emphasizes its 38 years of combined industry experience and a commitment to craftsmanship and customer service as the foundation of its operation.

old_description: Welcome to our fabrication shop- where precision meets craftsmanship. From complete race car chassis service and modifications to custom roll cages and fabricated components, we do it all. Stop by our shop for everything your race car needs to win.
about:
1320 Fabrication operates from a shop at 170 Penrod Court in Glen Burnie, Maryland. The founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available sources.

The shop specializes in custom metal fabrication for competition vehicles, with a focus on TIG welding of chromoly, stainless steel, aluminum, and titanium. Services include complete chassis work for hot rods, imports, bracket cars, dragsters, and promods; roll bars and cages built to SFI 25.1–25.5 specifications; mini tubs; stainless steel headers and exhaust systems; custom rear housings; suspension setup and scaling; fuel cell installation; turbo manifolds; intercoolers; carbon fiber components; Lexan windows; race jacks; and JR dragster builds.

Customers come primarily from the drag racing and hot rod segments, including bracket racers, professional drag teams, and JR dragster competitors. The company has a multi-year sponsorship relationship with Maryland International Raceway’s ET Series and was named the Series title sponsor for the Professional Drag Racers Association (PDRA).

The company emphasizes precision and craftsmanship in its fabrication work, but does not publish a formal statement on why it was founded or what specifically differentiates it from other race shops.

old_description: 21st CPC quality management system has been certified to ISO based standards since 1997
about:
21st Century Plastics Corp. operates from Potterville, Michigan, where it was founded in 1997. The company transitioned to 100 percent employee ownership in 2010 and has maintained an ISO-certified quality management system since its inception, achieving ISO 9001:2015 certification.

The facility houses 15 injection molding machines ranging from 55 to 1,500 tons, featuring high-pressure injection, closed-loop process control, and automatic mold data storage. Two table-travel CNC vertical mills machine steel, aluminum, and plastic, while an Airwolf 3D Axiom printer produces fixtures and verification equipment in over 40 materials. Secondary capabilities include spin welding, painting, surface grinding, manual machining, and offline assembly.

The company serves customers requiring custom molded components, precision machined parts, and 3D-printed tooling, though specific industry sectors are not publicly listed.

Employee ownership and a stated emphasis on personal service distinguish the operation; the company highlights its niche in customer service and deep expertise in molding.

old_description: 2GIG Engineering provides advanced tilt sensors for precise motion detection and leveling in demanding industrial and commercial applications. about:
2GIG Engineering, LLC is based in Abbot, Maine, and has been designing and assembling precision tilt sensors since 2015. The privately held company focuses on American-made inclinometers for industrial and commercial motion detection and leveling applications.

The product line spans wired and wireless inclinometers with output options including analog voltage, 4-20 mA, CANBUS, USB, RS232, and Modbus RTU, as well as switching relays and isolated dry-contact relays. Stainless-steel models and polycarbonate mounting accessories are also offered. All devices are designed and assembled in the company's Maine facility, with custom design and tailored solution services available for specialized requirements.

Primary markets include heavy machinery, construction, and renewable energy systems, where the sensors are used for precise angle measurement and leveling in harsh environments. The company also serves broader industrial and commercial customers worldwide.

2GIG emphasizes domestic manufacturing, custom engineering support, and direct customer service as its core differentiators, positioning its sensors as durable, high-precision alternatives for demanding applications.

old_description: 330 Electronics specializes in flexible PCB assembly built for OEMs and engineering teams. From prototypes to ongoing production, we deliver responsive support, consistent quality, and predictable lead times—without the constraints of high-volume manufacturers.
about:
Based in Buckner, Kentucky, 330 Electronics, LLC operates as a U.S.-based electronics manufacturing services provider specializing in flexible PCB assembly for original equipment manufacturers and engineering teams. The company focuses on low-volume, high-mix production runs, offering a responsive alternative to high-volume manufacturers.

Its core services span surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly, mixed-technology builds, selective and hand soldering, and full turnkey material procurement. Beyond circuit boards, the company delivers box-build integration including sub-assembly, final assembly, cable and harness integration, packaging, and fulfillment. A dedicated division designs and manufactures UL-listed custom temperature control systems, providing rapid prototype PCB fabrication, testing, and system integration.

The customer base includes OEM manufacturers seeking dependable production support, engineering and product development teams transitioning from prototype to production, and operations and supply chain leaders aiming to reduce complexity. Served industries explicitly cited are automotive electronics and renewable energy.

The company emphasizes U.S.-based manufacturing for shorter communication cycles and reduced supply chain uncertainty, an engineering-focused approach that simplifies development-to-production transitions, and scalable solutions tailored to changing requirements. Quality is integrated throughout the process with visual inspection, functional testing, and controlled manufacturing processes.

name: 406 Processing & Taxidermy
old_description: 406 Processing & Taxidermy is a whole animal butchery that provides year around services for farmers and ranchers including processing wild game during hunting season. 406 is a small-town, locally owned business.
about:
406 Processing & Taxidermy operates from Great Falls, Montana, where it runs a whole-animal butchery and taxidermy shop. The business is locally owned and operated by award-winning taxidermist Dylan Lencioni, an avid hunter and fisherman who frames the venture as a family endeavor. No founding year is disclosed in the available sources.

The company provides year-round processing for farmers, ranchers, and hunters. Its core services include wild-game processing (deer, elk, antelope), livestock slaughter and processing with an on-ranch harvesting option, European skull mounts cleaned using a beetle-based method that preserves bone integrity, and full taxidermy mounts produced by Brad Lencioni. The facility sits at 900 12th Street North; no square footage, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Customers are primarily central Montana ranchers who need USDA-style slaughter and cut-and-wrap services, as well as individual hunters during the fall season. The website lists set prices for European mounts — $195 for elk, $160 for deer — and notes that beetle cleaning is available for buffalo, bear, beef, and small game skulls.

The company emphasizes two differentiators: a guarantee that each client receives meat only from the animal they delivered, and the convenience of mobile on-ranch slaughtering. The beetle-cleaning process is highlighted as a way to maintain natural bone structure without shrinkage, and the taxidermy work is positioned as trophy-quality, using premium forms and materials.

Its services span kitchens, bath vanities, built‑ins, closets, garage storage systems, home offices, and commercial millwork such as reception desks and fixtures. Projects move from concept through design to on‑site installation, all handled in‑house.

The primary clientele are homeowners throughout Southern Maine, with a growing commercial segment that includes businesses needing custom reception desks and retail fixtures. The shop serves both residential and light‑commercial markets across the region.
